title: How Much Iron Do You Actually Absorb?

scenes.text: Only a tiny fraction of the iron you eat actually enters your bloodstream.
scenes.query2: how much dietary iron is absorbed

scenes.label: HEME IRON: 15‑35% ABSORPTION
scenes.text: Iron from animal sources (heme) is absorbed at about 15 to 35 percent, the highest of any food type.

scenes.label: NON‑HEME IRON: 2‑20% ABSORPTION
scenes.text: Plant‑based (non‑heme) iron is taken up at roughly 2 to 20 percent, depending on diet composition.

scenes.label: VITAMIN C BOOSTS ABSORPTION
scenes.text: Consuming vitamin C with iron‑rich foods can double non‑heme iron absorption.
